attr.title: Cassette Beasts
attr.desc: An open-world monster-collecting RPG. Record monsters onto cassette tapes, transform into them in turn-based battles, and fuse them with your partner while exploring the island of New Wirral.
attr.inst: Steam or Epic Games Store version. Copy CassetteBeasts.pck from the game's folder into ports/cassettebeasts/gamedata (DLC: the game's dlc folder too). The first launch converts the game for 1 GB devices (about 3 minutes, about 450 MB of free space).
